title: Copilot Corporate Stats
description: Collects M365 Copilot usage, prompts, org hierarchy and licence data from Microsoft Graph and ingests metrics. After import, edit the SETTINGS block in the "config" task - every other task reads from it. The schedule is imported switched off - enable it after a successful manual run.

config.name: config
config.description: EDIT ME — tenant ID, credential vault ID, departments, value rates

collect.name: collect
collect.description: Usage report → org metrics, agent inventory, batch plan

aggregate.name: aggregate
aggregate.description: Merge, resolve departments, ingest per-user/per-app/health metrics

plan_retry.name: plan_retry
plan_retry.description: Find users missing or incomplete after first pass

retry_prompts.name: retry_prompts
retry_prompts.description: Second pass for incomplete users (smaller batches)

studio_exec_costs.name: studio_exec_costs
studio_exec_costs.description: OPTIONAL, disabled by default - Copilot Studio credit consumption (Power Platform API). Needs its own config and bizevents.ingest scope

copilot_licence_pull.name: copilot_licence_pull
copilot_licence_pull.description: Purchased/assigned seats and per-user licence list. Settings come from the config task
